## What's Changed

- Migrate to MultiLoader.
- Support almost all languages in https://minecraft.wiki/w/Language (by AI).
- Support Minecraft 26.3.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jaxvanyang/simple_chess/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

| Mod Loader | Supported Minecraft Versions |
|:-|:-|
| NeoForge | `1.20.4` - `26.2` |
| Fabric | `1.19` - `26.2` |

## New Features
- Capture a piece by right clicking one with a piece in the main hand.
- Add Korea & Japan localization.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jaxvanyang/simple_chess/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

| Mod Loader | Supported Minecraft Versions |
|:-|:-|

| Fabric | `1.20.4` - `26.2` |
